race.comment: Open affair. FIRST CHORUS (8) has been flying over the Winter and backs up from a good win at Caulfield Heath last week over 1800m. She'll get soft ground again and back in trip is fine, albeit off a seven-day break. She looks the starting point. LIGHT INFANTRY MAN (3) resumes. He's the obvious class of the race as a multiple G1 Australian Cup winner and he did win over this route first up last campaign however the tempo there was brutal and he outstayed his rivals. Not sure he can do it off a slow speed with 62kg. DARKBONEE (13) caught the eye with a big finish first up at Flemington and now drops 8.5kg. He's progressive, just wary of how far back he might get again - track pattern is key. JUST FOLK (2) continues to race well and draws for every hope.
